name: SIA
short_description: Sunwave Intelligent Assistant embedded in Sunwave EMR that generates BPS assessments, progress notes, and discharge summaries with 42 CFR Part 2 compliance.
long_description: SIA (Sunwave Intelligent Assistant) is an AI documentation tool built directly into Sunwave Health's EMR, CRM, and RCM platform for behavioral health and addiction treatment. Unlike bolt-on AI solutions, SIA is embedded in every workflow - documentation, reporting, and clinical decision support. It generates BPS assessments, group notes, individual progress notes, and discharge summaries while clinicians maintain oversight through human-in-the-loop review. Sunwave is the first behavioral health platform to earn ISO 42001 certification for ethical AI, and SIA meets 42 CFR Part 2 compliance for SUD records. JourneyPure reported 44 minutes saved per BPS assessment, 55%+ documentation time reduction, 46% improvement in documentation quality, and reduced AMA rates from 27% to 19% after implementing SIA.
one_liner: ISO 42001 certified AI documentation for Sunwave EMR with 42 CFR Part 2 compliance.

faqs.q: What is SIA by Sunwave Health?
faqs.a: SIA (Sunwave Intelligent Assistant) is an AI documentation tool embedded in Sunwave's EMR, CRM, and RCM platform. It generates BPS assessments, group notes, progress notes, and discharge summaries with human-in-the-loop review.

faqs.q: Is SIA compliant with 42 CFR Part 2 for addiction treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, SIA meets 42 CFR Part 2 compliance requirements specific to SUD (substance use disorder) records. Sunwave is also the first behavioral health platform to earn ISO 42001 certification for ethical AI.

faqs.q: How much time does SIA save clinicians?
faqs.a: JourneyPure reported 44 minutes saved per BPS assessment alone, with clinicians reclaiming over 55% of documentation time. BPS assessment completion rates improved from 59% to 89%, and documentation quality scores increased 46%.

SIA is part of the Sunwave EMR platform, which is estimated at $800-$4,500/month depending on organization size. Pricing is best suited for mid-sized and enterprise behavioral health organizations. Contact Sunwave for a custom quote.
